verdict.rationale: Twenty's docs explicitly state API keys can be scoped to a specific role to limit access (twenty-docs-24), backed by granular RBAC at object/field/record level (twenty-docs-7, twenty-docs-39, twenty-docs-54) and an explicit permission model constraining AI agents to only what the user/role can view (twenty-docs-19, twenty-docs-5). This directly supports issuing least-privilege credentials for an agent. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that role-scoped keys work as documented, and no explicit agent-specific key-issuance workflow beyond general role scoping.
